frames.narration: The app needs a fraud check. It has no networking code: it calls the sidecar on localhost.
The sidecar logs the request and forwards it over the network.
The first attempt times out. The sidecar, not the app, decides what happens next. It may only retry a call that is safe to repeat, and a fraud check is a read.
The app receives the answer. It never saw the failure.
To change the retry policy, the platform team updates the sidecar. No application is rebuilt, in any language.
